100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On October 7, 1926, the League of Nations convened in Geneva, addressing ongoing tensions in Europe following World War I. In the United States, the stock market showed signs of instability, raising concerns among investors. Meanwhile, in the realm of entertainment, the successful Broadway production of "Show Boat" continued to draw large crowds, showcasing a new era in American musical theater.
